eligibility.quote: There is a heavy mismatch here between the message/C++ types and Python types. `string` is 8-bit data which does not have encoding, neither does `std::string`. Message strings *ought* to be UTF-8, but this is not enforced. But Python strings always enforce an encoding.

failed_conditions.quote: So it is perfectly possible to publish data from C++, which gets mangled when received in Python.

loudness.quote:

    msg_info = _rclpy.rclpy_take(capsule, sub.msg_type, sub.raw)
UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0x80 in position 15: invalid start byte

resolution.quote:
With https://github.com/ros2/rosidl_python/pull/176 merged, I believe this issue is resolved for Rolling.

Since this is a significant behavior change, I'm not sure it's worth backporting to existing distros.  (PR 176 'Change decode mode into replace.' verified merged 2022-08-09; foxy backport PR 181 verified merged 2022-10-18 as 3788639b)
